text.content:
meaning: The Golden Flame

  • The economic hub, Kaljékor sits at the crossroads of major trade routes. Its pyramidal temple complex doubles as a marketplace, bustling with merchants from Ta’ kheperu and the Valyrian Sea and beyond.
  • Kaljékor is ruled by a council of priest-nobles
  • Known for its golden adornments and the wealth of its priest-nobles, Kaljékor’s influence extends far through trade alliances.
